## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List the commands and results, including skipped checks and environment requirements.

## Compatibility

Describe any API, configuration, stored-data, or operational impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Generated files match their source definitions, if changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, or local state are included.
- [ ] Remaining limitations are documented.
- [ ] Trust-boundary, profile or ownership changes are reflected in `docs/SECURITY.md`, `SECURITY.md` and the README limits.
